PRESENCE_MASK_ANATOMY.scope: every (security_key_v1, session_date) that has ANY bar in stageA_input
PRESENCE_MASK_ANATOMY.method: max(case when interval_index=i) for i in 0..3, grouped
PRESENCE_MASK_ANATOMY.WHAT_THE_653_ACTUALLY_ARE: (security, session) pairs that have NO bars at all — the security was not in the universe on that date (not yet regular-way, or gone). They are NOT incomplete opening hours; they do not exist as episodes at all.
PRESENCE_MASK_ANATOMY.confirmed_by: the raw ingest already records NOT_YET_REGULAR_WAY per security-session

PER_PAIR_DECISIVE_COUNTS.definition: required two positions present BUT not all four
PER_PAIR_DECISIVE_COUNTS.meaning: there is NOT ONE episode anywhere in the frozen window where a pair's two positions exist and a third or fourth does not

COUNT_A_VS_COUNT_B.relation: IDENTICAL BY CONSTRUCTION on this data — the two universes are the same set, because the presence mask is 1111 for every existing episode and empty otherwise
COUNT_A_VS_COUNT_B.why_not_computed_twice: running both would produce the same numbers by proof, not by measurement. The presence-mask census IS the comparison, and it is exhaustive over all 596,251 episodes.
COUNT_A_VS_COUNT_B.structural_reason: the frozen coarse producer derives intervals from the XNYS schedule; a session yields 26 intervals (or 14 on an early close). A session either exists with all of its intervals or does not exist. A 4-interval opening hour is therefore not constructible in part.

EMPIRICAL_ORACLE_TEST.method: rebuilt the full X-support census from the PERSISTED POS4 under the frozen X_positive_episode_n definition and compared against the sealed pre-Y oracle
EMPIRICAL_ORACLE_TEST.coverage: all 45,387 claims of the frozen universe, therefore all 20,751 registered ones

STATUS_OF_THE_FROZEN_SPEC.why: Option A reproduces the sealed oracle EXACTLY on every claim. Option B would too. The distinction the spec draws is REAL but EMPIRICALLY INERT over the frozen window.
STATUS_OF_THE_FROZEN_SPEC.what_is_NOT_claimed: that the historical authors consciously chose Option A. The data cannot distinguish the two, and no artifact text settles it either.

On the frozen window that group restriction removes nothing, but the phrasing must carry it because forward behaviour is not guaranteed by this window's evidence.

4a.setup: an unrelated position EXISTS but its feature is NON_VALID
4a.status: testable on real data; this is the case that distinguishes Option A from a naive all-four-AVAILABILITY gate

4b.setup: an unrelated position is physically MISSING
4b.expect: under Option A the pair counts; under Option B it does not
4b.status: SYNTHETIC ONLY — it cannot be tested against history because history contains no such episode. Any B implementation must therefore make its choice EXPLICIT in code rather than inherit it silently.
4b.REQUIREMENT: the B implementation must assert the presence mask and HARD FAIL on any episode whose mask is not 1111, so that the first forward occurrence surfaces as a decision rather than as a silent count difference
